description: This file defines a generic concurrent object pool implementation in C#, including a specific implementation that uses a thread-local stack for object management, within the Orleans.Serialization.Invocation namespace.

classes.name: ConcurrentObjectPool<T>
classes.description: A sealed class inheriting from a generic concurrent object pool with a default policy, providing a parameterless constructor.

classes.name: ConcurrentObjectPool<T, TPoolPolicy>
classes.description: A generic class implementing an object pool with thread-local storage, supporting custom pooling policies and maximum pool size.

methods.name: ConcurrentObjectPool()
methods.description: Constructor initializing the base class with a new default policy.

methods.name: ConcurrentObjectPool(TPoolPolicy policy)
methods.description: Constructor accepting a pooling policy to initialize the pool.

methods.name: Get()
methods.description: Retrieves an object from the pool, creating a new one if necessary.

methods.name: Return(T obj)
methods.description: Returns an object to the pool if the policy permits and the pool is not full.
